description:
Returns information about the authenticated API key.

HTTP: GET /v1/me
Category: Core
Required scopes: none (any valid API key)
Returns: {status, data: object {id, name, key_prefix, user_id, scopes, rate_limit_tier, status, last_used_at, expires_at, created_at}}
Read-only.
name: panelica_core_get_v1_me
